title: BCG vaccination and tuberculosis in children: a systematic review

protocol.title: BCG vaccination and tuberculosis in children: a systematic review
protocol.question: What is the effect of BCG vaccination on tuberculosis in children?
protocol.objectives: Estimate the risk ratio of tuberculosis after BCG vaccination in children.
protocol.rationale: BCG policy differs by latitude and the evidence needs a structured synthesis.

eligibility.include: Randomized trials of BCG in children

runs.preparation: Log risk ratios and their variances

sensitivity.result: The estimate stayed in the same range.

declarations.conflicts: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.dataAvailability: Data are in the project record.

sections.heading: Title
paragraphs: BCG vaccination and tuberculosis in children: a systematic review

sections.heading: Abstract
paragraphs: Methods searched two databases. Results included 12 studies.

sections.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: Tuberculosis in children remains a reason to examine BCG.

sections.heading: Information sources
paragraphs: PubMed was last searched on 2024-01-15. Europe PMC was last searched on 2024-01-16.

sections.heading: Results
paragraphs: The flow diagram shows 120 records identified and 12 studies included.

sections.heading: Discussion
paragraphs: We read these findings in the light of other evidence from earlier BCG trials.
Limitations of the included evidence include short follow-up in some trials.
Limitations of the review methods include searching two databases only.
Implications for practice and future research remain open until more trials report.
